#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;

LL repunit(int k) {
    LL val = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) val = val * 10 + 1;
    return val;
}

int solve(LL n, int i) {
    if (i == 0) return 0;
    LL ri = repunit(i);
    int t = i * (n / ri);
    n %= ri;
    if (n == 0) return t;
    return t + min(i + solve(ri - n, i - 1), solve(n, i - 1));
}

int main() {
    LL n;
    cin >> n;
    cout << solve(n, 16) << endl;
    return 0;
}

    int t = i * (n / ones[i]);

    return res;
}
